flags: WATERFRONT: lakeview confirmed (no --AWH). On the brochure map the drive-in sites nearest the lake are 701-703 (behind the long beach parking lot and the swimming beach, both day use) and 711-712 at the south end of the shoreline walk-to group; the shore sites 704-710 are walk-to, tent-only. On Esri imagery every loop is under continuous pine canopy; the only open ground at the shore is the beach and its lot (about 45.8660,-89.6465 to 45.8650,-89.6445). No drive-in site is on open ground within about 50 m, so no upgrade; a filtered view from 701-703 and 711-712 supports lakeview.
